title: Ukubwa wa Nomino (Theme 14: Matumizi ya pesa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child makes the big form (ji- / j- / ma- for the plural) and gives it LI-YA agreement (jibwa limebweka, majibwa yamebweka).

floor.prerequisite: Makes big forms of ki- nouns.
floor.question: Ukubwa wa "kitabu" ni?

representations: pictures of ordinary and huge things
a rule card per noun type
contexts: use of money: a huge building in town
a folk tale with a giant dog

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "jibwa", "Jibwa limebweka" and "Majibwa yamebweka".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jibwa ni nini?" Kwa nini "mbwa mdogo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibwa ni mbwa mkubwa: hali ya ukubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kiambishi kipi cha ukubwa?" Kwa nini "ki-" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiambishi cha ukubwa ni ji-, kama jitu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jumba ni nini?" Kwa nini "nyumba ndogo" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa nomino ya ukubwa huchukua ma-: majibwa.
